math_model.scope: Exact local rational Clifford(4,3) bosonic pointwise model only, six fixed nondegenerate oriented and orientation-reversing Lorentzian coframes, not complete E8, all SpinN or global actions.
math_model.higgs_vacuum: phi0=v*gamma4, v^2>0, e'=e and T=0 as additional Eq27 solution restrictions
math_model.unbroken_internal_u1: Generator U=gamma5*gamma6, U^2=-1 (negative Clifford scalar part), [U,gamma4]=0, so a U(1) internal gauge direction preserves the selected Higgs vacuum.
math_model.off_shell_perturbation: Hold background gravitational/Higgs connection, frame and Hodge star fixed, shift A -> A+epsilon*U*alpha in the commuting internal gauge direction. Locally F0=0 and F(shift)=epsilon*U*d(alpha), because U commutes with the Higgs carrier and abelian A wedge A vanishes.
math_model.electric_magnetic_coordinates: alpha_E=x0 dx1 yields d alpha_E=dx0 wedge dx1; alpha_B=x2 dx3 yields d alpha_B=dx2 wedge dx3 in an orthonormal Lorentz frame, extend by basis transport under independent coframes.
math_model.pointwise_second_variation: Clifford scalar <U^2>=-1. Lorentzian metric twoform norms satisfy ||dx0 wedge dx1||^2=-1, ||dx2 wedge dx3||^2=+1; hence <F_E wedge *F_E>/vol_e=+epsilon^2, <F_B wedge *F_B>/vol_e=-epsilon^2. Thus the chosen Lorentzian pointwise quadratic action has opposite-sign offshell directions even when g≠0; F0=0 alone is not a positive-definite variational minimum theorem.
math_model.independent_math_oracles: Compute Lorentzian Hodge from exact coordinate inverse tetrad/metric and signed wedge, compare Hodge scalar pairing with orthonormal vector wedge metric times independent Clifford bitmask square.
math_model.vacuum_scalar_potential: At fixed R_scalar0=3v^2, the restricted Higgs polynomial V(x)=-R_scalar0*x/16+3*x^2/32 has derivative zero at x=v^2 and Hessian +3/16. Restricted scalar stationarity is compatible with an indefinite full Lorentzian curvature-squared functional.
math_model.what_must_not_be_claimed: Local sign witnesses do not themselves prove that the source's actual selected on-shell solution family includes all compactly supported offshell gauge perturbations, nor disprove a Euclidean positive-energy or restricted-boundary notion of minimum; no source author error is established.
